title: H189 — The Self-Exciting Detector
chapter: LI — When Silence Hides a Change
detection_rule: Residual > ε; update only when exactly one candidate delay remains feasible.
observability_rule: All pairs of candidate delayed predictions must differ by >2ε.
self_excitation_rule: If not observable, inject diagnostic pulse, at most one every five updates.
limitations: Assumes exact known input waveform and disturbance bounds
One unannounced delay change per trial
No physically demonstrated Planck-scale Rupert engine
No extractable CMB/CMD kinetic power demonstrated
Supporting Lean lemmas not independently compiled
